rv.q: This is the right show to start the season.

Under the sharp direction of Jeffrey Cass and the spirited musical guidance of Phil Videckis, The Rocky Horror Show Live at Brightside Theatre explodes with vigor, irreverence, and irresistible charm.
Featuring Jeffrey Cass’ Salvador Daliesque Direction, and filled with spunk and spirit, this show gives audiences nothing but absolute pleasure.
Whether you’re a “virgin” to the show or an already converted “phantom,” BrightSide’s “Rocky Horror” is a killer production that is out of this world fun.

cn.t: Critics embrace this glitter-drenched production as a wild, chaotic party that successfully captures the cult classic's campy, gender-bending spirit, with praise for its rock 'n' roll energy and audience participation.
